title: I got to check out a sneak peek of @South Asian Spring Awakening and ...
transcript: I love when a new production of a show is able to take a musical that, you know and present it in a completely new lens. I'm thinking cats the Jellicle ball. I'm thinking La Cage Aux Folles at New York City Center. And this new production of Spring Awakening is doing something similar, presenting Spring Awakening but with an all South Asian cast. I was invited into the rehearsal room to get a sneak peek at some of the songs, as well as to hear from some of the cast and creative team about what it is like creating this new version of the show without changing a line of dialogue, without changing any of the orchestrations, and getting to hear more about their approach for this production and some of the parallels that they are drawing between South Asian culture and the text of Spring Awakening. It made me really excited to check out this production once it is fully staged. I mean, one of my all time favorite Broadway experiences was seeing Michael Arden's Deaf West production of Spring Awakening and the way that that production was able to spotlight a community that I wasn't very familiar with and in the process highlight new themes in the text and make you see the show through fresh eyes. It seems like this production is poised to do something very similar. Now, I wanna be very clear that this is not an official revival. This is a licensed production that just happens To be being done in New York. And it's different from the one that just had that big open call. But this promises to be a very unique production that deserves just as much attention. And if you wanna check it out, it is running August 14th through September 6th at ART/New York Theatres on 53rd Street.
classificationReason: Creator attended a rehearsal sneak peek, not a staged performance, and explicitly says they're excited to see it 'once it is fully staged.' The show (South Asian Spring Awakening) is not on the provided list, and no first-hand opinion of a live production is offered.
